title: NCR Atleos introduces AllTM, an ATM solution designed for retailers, aimed at driving traffic, revenue and customer engagement
summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced AllTM, an ATM solution that helps US retailers transform the ATM from a traditional cash access point into a powerful driver of foot traffic, customer engagement and revenue growth through expanded capabilities.
body_markdown:
ATLANTA -- NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced AllTM, an ATM solution that helps US retailers transform the ATM from a traditional cash access point into a powerful driver of foot traffic, customer engagement and revenue growth through expanded capabilities.


“Designed for retailers ranging from single-store operators to some of the nation's largest retail enterprises, AllTM enables retailers to leverage the ATM as a strategic business asset that can attract customers and increase store visits, while Atleos manages the operational complexity," said Steven Nogalo, General Manager, North America for Atleos. "AllTM helps retailers unlock more value from the ATM by transforming it into a high-frequency financial destination that serves customers where they already shop while creating meaningful business benefits for retailers."


AllTM goes well beyond traditional cash withdrawal services by bringing a broad range of self-service financial capabilities into the retail environment. Through a single, small footprint solution, retailers can offer services including cash withdrawals, consumer deposits, store deposits, bill payment, cardless transactions and other self-service financial experiences designed to meet consumers' everyday financial needs. The offering helps retailers expand financial access, deliver cash management benefits within the store, and solve growing labor and cash handling challenges presented by over-the-counter financial offerings while creating more opportunities to engage customers and drive repeat visits.


By meeting consumers where they already shop, AllTM transforms the ATM from a basic cash dispenser into a destination point that consumers seek out for everyday financial transactions; driving foot traffic, repeat visits and incremental sales. Atleos research and experience show that ATM users can spend more in-store than non-users, while many make purchases during the same visit, creating opportunities to increase customer traffic, engagement and basket size.


The introduction of AllTM formalizes a comprehensive retail offering that has been helping retailers create value through self-service financial access for years. By bringing these capabilities together, Atleos is making it easier for retailers to understand, evaluate and deploy solutions that align with their customer experience, growth and operational objectives.


"As retailers continue looking for ways to differentiate the customer experience, the ATM can play a much larger role than many realize," said Nogalo. "AllTM helps retailers leverage self-service financial access as a strategic advantage, creating more reasons for customers to visit, engage and return."


For more information about AllTM, visit:[https://www.ncratleos.com/retail/alltm-by-ncr-atleos](https://www.ncratleos.com/retail/alltm-by-ncr-atleos)
